en.name: Fruit nectar
en.summary: An unopened can or carton of fruit nectar keeps 12–18 months from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Once you open it, refrigerate it and drink it quickly: nectar is thick, sweet and low in acid, which makes it a much better growth medium than a sharp citrus juice.
en.pantry: 12–18 months from purchase while the pack is sealed, somewhere cool, dark and dry. Nectar is fruit purée diluted with water and sweetened, then heat-treated and sealed, and it is the processing and the pack that give it the shelf life — not the fruit. Tropical nectars such as papaya, mango, guava and soursop are noticeably less acidic than orange or apple juice, so once the seal is broken there is less to hold microbes back. Reject any can that is dented at the seam, swollen or leaking.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for opened nectar, but the rule is clear enough: an opened pack belongs in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, capped, and it should be drunk within a few days rather than left to linger. A sweet, thick, low-acid drink in an opened container is close to an ideal medium for yeasts and moulds. Decant an opened can into a glass bottle or jar, keep it on a shelf and not in the door, and pour into a glass rather than drinking from the container.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for fruit nectar. Freezing works in practice — nectar makes excellent ice lollies and sorbet, which is a better use for a half-finished carton than trying to keep it as a drink — but there is no published figure. Decant into a container with headspace, because the liquid expands and a can or carton will split.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and shake or stir it well since nectar separates. Treat thawed nectar as an opened pack and finish it quickly.
spoilage: A swollen, bulging or leaking can — do not open it, and do not taste it.
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell instead of a sweet fruit one.
Mould on the surface or around the rim of an opened container.
tips: Buy single-serve cans if you drink it occasionally; nectar does not keep well once opened.
Decant an opened can into a glass jar — juice left in an opened can picks up a metallic taste.
Freeze leftovers as ice lollies rather than trying to keep them as a drink.
Never use a can that is swollen or dented along a seam.

faq.q: How long does fruit nectar keep?
faq.a: 12–18 months from purchase while the can or carton is sealed, in a cool, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Does opened nectar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes. No figure is published for the opened pack, but nectar is sweet and low in acid, so it goes in the fridge and should be drunk within a few days.
No freezer timeline is published. Freezing it as ice lollies or sorbet is a good use for leftovers; decant first and leave headspace for expansion.

zh.name: 果汁蜜（nectar）
zh.summary: 未開封的罐裝或盒裝果汁蜜，自購買日起放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 12～18 個月。一旦開封就要冷藏，而且要快點喝完：果汁蜜濃稠、含糖高、酸度低，比起酸度高的柑橘汁，它是好得多的培養基。
zh.pantry: 未開封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 12～18 個月。果汁蜜是果泥加水稀釋、加糖，再經過熱處理與密封的東西；給它保存期的是加工與包裝，不是水果本身。木瓜、芒果、芭樂、刺果番荔枝這類熱帶果汁蜜的酸度，明顯低於柳橙汁或蘋果汁，所以封口一破，能壓制微生物的力量就更少了。罐身接縫凹陷、鼓脹或滲漏的，一律不要用。
zh.fridge: 開封後的果汁蜜沒有公布的冷藏期限，但規則本身夠清楚：開封後就該蓋好放進 4 °C 以下冷藏，並且在幾天內喝完，不要一直留著。一個又甜又稠、酸度又低的飲料放在開口容器裡，對酵母和霉菌來說幾乎是理想環境。請把開過的罐頭倒進玻璃瓶或罐子，放冰箱層架而不是門邊，並且倒進杯子喝，不要對著容器口喝。
zh.freezer: 果汁蜜沒有公布的冷凍期限。實務上冷凍可行——拿來做冰棒或雪酪非常好，對半罐喝不完的東西來說，這比想辦法留成飲料實際得多——但沒有公開數字。請先倒進留有膨脹空間的容器，因為液體結凍會變大，罐頭或紙盒會被撐裂。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面上；果汁蜜會分層，解凍後要搖勻或攪勻。解凍後當成已開封的產品，盡快喝完。
spoilage: 罐身鼓脹、膨起或滲漏——不要開，也不要嚐。
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味，而不是甜甜的果香。
開封容器的液面或瓶口長霉。
tips: 偶爾才喝就買單份小罐；果汁蜜開封後並不耐放。
開過的罐頭要倒進玻璃罐——留在開口罐頭裡會有金屬味。
喝不完做成冰棒，比想辦法留成飲料好。
罐身鼓脹或接縫凹陷的，絕對不要用。

faq.a: 未開封的罐裝或盒裝，放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 12～18 個月。

faq.q: 開封後的果汁蜜要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 要。開封後沒有公布的數字，但果汁蜜甜、酸度低，所以請放冷藏，並在幾天內喝完。
沒有公布的冷凍期限。喝不完拿來做冰棒或雪酪是好用法；請先倒出來並留膨脹空間。
